rationale: The advisory's own press release framing names the mechanism directly: 'Operation Economic Outcast Targets Iran's Shadow Fleet Networks' (page 1). The designations that follow develop the shadow-fleet network structure the doctrine describes: a Panama/Greece-registered front entity, KARNAKIS AND KARNAKIS, tying together five Panamanian individuals who share a surname/address pattern; a Panama-flagged vessel-owning entity, ROXETTE MARITIME SHIPPING AND TRADING S.A., linked to seven bulk/general cargo vessels (page 2); and a UAE shipping line, WHALES SHIPPING LINE LLC, linked to AMIGOZ SINGAPORE PTE. LTD. and two crew/supply vessels (pages 2-3). This is the sanctions-family twin (SAN002/PAT008); the advisory is framed as a sanctions-evasion designation action, so SAN002 is preferred per the twin convention.
